 Josh Koplewicz – Flexible Capital and Creative Structures at Thayer Street (EP.451) 
 
 Josh Koplewicz – Flexible Capital and Creative Structures at Thayer Street (EP.451) Jun 12, 2025

 Josh Koplewicz is the Managing Partner of Thayer Street
Partners, a boutique private equity firm he founded in 2012 that
provides flexible growth capital to lower middle market companies
in financial and business services.

 

Our conversation traces Josh’s journey from his early fascination
with business and real estate to building Thayer Street into an
institutional platform. We discuss the lessons he learned at
Goldman Sachs and his transition from scrappy dealmaker to fund
manager. We cover Thayer Street’s thematic sourcing, deal
structuring, and portfolio construction, the evolving landscape for
non-bank growth capital, challenges of scaling a boutique firm, and
Josh’s vision for Thayer Street’s future.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
